name: list-received-emails
description:
**Purpose:** List emails received (inbox) by your Resend receiving address. Use for "show my inbox", "what emails did I get?", "list incoming mail".

**NOT for:** Listing emails you sent (use list-emails). Not for listing broadcasts (use list-broadcasts).

**Returns:** Paginated metadata: from, to, subject, received time. Use get-received-email with an ID for full content.

limit.description: Number of emails to retrieve. Default: 20, Max: 100, Min: 1

after.description: Email ID after which to retrieve more emails (for forward pagination). Cannot be used with "before".

before.description: Email ID before which to retrieve more emails (for backward pagination). Cannot be used with "after".
